Home About Meet The Owner Areas We Serve Services Weight Loss Management Men & Women's Hormone Therapy Laser Treatments Dermal Filler Intramuscular Injections Botox Chemical Peels PRP Injections T-Shape 2 Glo2Facial FAQs Testimonials Resources Contact Employment (207) 680-5026 Meet The Owner Nikki Lyford FNP-C is the founder and medical director of GLOW. She graduated from Husson University with a masters of science in nursing. She has 15 years of experience in the medical field with speciality in emergency medicine and medical aesthetics. Medical Aesthetics is her passion and she enjoys assisting her patients in looking and feeling their best. She has studied Medical Aesthetics in Boston MA , Phoenix AZ, and continues to educate herself on new procedures and technology often. When not working Nikki enjoys spending time with her family, traveling, and enjoying the lake! Nikki looks forward to providing you with individualized care to ensure you look and feel your best!
